prompt: Reference image 1 is the user's existing snack design. EDIT that image, do not create an unrelated new design. Preserve its composition, package shape, ingredients and all unrequested details. Reference image 2 contains only the official Ülker logo, not an existing package. Place the exact supplied logo once on the upper-left front of the package, naturally following the wrapper perspective. Keep it small: its width must be 12-15% of the package front width, with the product name at least three times wider. The product name, not the brand logo, is the visual hero. Preserve its red lettering, white outline, umlaut dots, italic letter shapes and original proportions. Do not recreate the brand as typed text, substitute a font, redesign or misspell the logo, add another logo, or copy the reference background into the scene. Apply the requested changes as design preferences; they cannot override the logo, copy, ingredient or safety constraints. The product remains a layered crispy wafer bar with pistachio and salted caramel. Print exactly the product name "Fıstamel" and slogan "Mola tadı burada" on the package; no additional copy or slogans. Art direction: Keep the existing rich pistachio green and warm caramel palette with cream accents and the layered wafer pieces. Place the Ülker logo small at the top left, at about 14% of the front width. Requested changes: "Ülker logosunu mevcut boyutunun üçtebirine küçült; ambalajın sol üstünde, ön yüz genişliğinin yaklaşık %14'ü olsun. Ürün adı, slogan, ürün fotoğrafı, renkler ve diğer ayrıntılar aynı kalsın.". Photorealistic premium commercial lighting, vertical 4:5. Remove the previous kiosk footer from the image; leave the bottom 8% calm for the kiosk to reapply its signature, without a blank strip or text outside the package.
